description: Open a new tab, switch to a tab by ID (from virtual_desk), or close one. Prefer 'open' over navigate when the user's active tab must stay untouched. Refs from the previous tab are invalid afterwards — call view_page before acting.

tab.description: Tab ID or 1-based number (switch/close; close: active tab)

url.description: URL for a new tab (open); default about:blank

name: switch_tab
